title: Dun Morogh
body: Dun Morogh is the snowbound heart of Khaz Modan, a high country of frozen lakes, pine forests and wind-scoured ridges walled in by mountains. It is the homeland of the Ironforge dwarves, whose great city is carved into the mountain at its heart, and it was home to the gnomes until their city of Gnomeregan was lost. The Frostmane ice trolls once ruled these snows and trouble the dwarves still, and now troggs have poured out of the deep places too, while much of King Magni's army fights far away.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dun_Morogh_(Classic) (snowy region, Khaz Modan mountains on all sides, passes guarded by dwarven troops, home of gnomes and dwarves)
warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Frostmane_tribe (once ruled Dun Morogh, empire fell to dwarven armies, retreat to the hills)

title: Coldridge Valley
body: Coldridge Valley is a sheltered vale in the southwestern corner of Dun Morogh, where young dwarves and gnomes take their first steps as defenders of Khaz Modan. Its settlement of Anvilmar is dug into the mountainside, and its snowfields are far from peaceful: Frostmane trolls hold a cave at its southern end, and troggs have spread across its hills.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Coldridge_Valley (southwestern corner, dwarf and gnome start before Cataclysm)
quest 233 description (Talin's camp by the frozen lake)

title: Kharanos
body: Kharanos is the heart of Dun Morogh, a dwarven town nestled among the peaks on the road north to Ironforge. Its pride is the Thunderbrew Distillery, home of Thunder Ale, and the family guards its recipes jealously: Dark Iron dwarves have already stolen the one for Thunderbrew Lager, and the rival Barleybrews of Brewnall Village would love to see their own Scalder on its taps.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Kharanos (bustling town among the peaks, large forge, gnomish workshop, Thunderbrew Distillery, recruits from Anvilmar train there)

title: Steelgrill's Depot
body: Just northeast of Kharanos stands Steelgrill's Depot, the shop of Beldin Steelgrill, reckoned the best siege engine mechanic there is. It is a favorite haunt of the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, and gnomes come to its yard to buy and learn to ride the mechanostriders their people build.

parts.body: Of late the yard is crowded with Gnomeregan trainees and half-assembled mechano-tanks, for the exiles are readying machines and recruits for an assault to take back their city.

title: Frostmane Hold
body: Frostmane Hold is the stronghold of the Frostmane ice trolls, a cave in the hills southwest of Brewnall Village. Their empire once spanned Dun Morogh, until the dwarves broke it and drove the survivors into the hills, a shameful blow to so warlike a people. Their patriarch, Great Father Arctikus, still walks the snows around it.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Frostmane_tribe (empire fell to dwarven armies, shameful blow to their warlike nature, Frostmane Hold their capital, Arctikus patriarch)
quest 1678 description (Vejrek's hut south of Frostmane Hold)

title: Gnomeregan
body: In the western hills of Dun Morogh lies the surface entrance to Gnomeregan, once the capital of the gnomes. When troggs invaded from below, the gnomes fought back with a radiation purge that went horribly wrong, poisoning their own city and killing or twisting a great many of its people. The survivors fled to Ironforge, and leper gnomes, their minds clouded by sickness, now haunt the land before the gates.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gnomeregan (trogg invasion, radiation plan, heavy losses, refugees to Ironforge, entrance in western Dun Morogh)
